### 🚀 v1.1.0 Release Notes — 🚗 Facebook Marketplace Scraper API Suite: Local Deals, Used Cars, Real Estate & Listing Status (`$1.50 / 1K`)

Zero-login Facebook Marketplace Scraper API suite on Apify (`$1.50 / 1,000 items`). Extract local classified deals, used cars & odometer mileage, rental & real estate properties, seller ratings, GPS coordinates, HD photo carousels, and live sold/available status checks across 100+ countries.

- 📓 **1-Click Interactive Google Colab Notebook:** [**Open `notebooks/quickstart.ipynb` in Colab**](https://colab.research.google.com/github/unitbytes/Facebook-Marketplace-Scraper-API/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb)
- 🤖 **AI Coding Agent MCP Ready:** Includes `.cursor/mcp.json` for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code.
- 🔧 **9-Node n8n Automation Workflows:** Ready-to-import `.json` templates under `n8n/` and at **[unitbytes.com/n8n](https://unitbytes.com/n8n/)**.

- **Zero Login or Cookies Required:** Operates 100% anonymously without personal accounts or session tokens.

- **Permanent Media CDNs:** High-resolution image and video links that never expire or return 403 Forbidden.
